venues.name: Toad's Place

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Pick up tickets 1/2 hour before show. Customers must present the actual credit card used to purchase the tickets and two forms of ID, including a photo ID.

venues.parkingDetail: Street parking metered after 6:00pm. Non-facility parking lots also available in area.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This is an accessible venue. Patrons requesting accessible seating may purchase and use a regular ticket and will be accommodated at the door. Call ahead and arrive 15 minutes early.

generalInfo.generalRule: 21 and older to drink. No photographic or recording devices allowed.

ada.adaCustomCopy:
Toad's Place is an "all general admission" venue.  Patrons requesting accessible seating may purchase and use a regular general admission
ticket.  Please click "Back" to previous page and continue with standard purchase.

* Box office information is subject to change.
